Name: Yandere Alex Dialogue Expansion
Author: Kxgarashii
Description:
[left][i][size=1][/size][/i][/left][center][i][size=1]This is my first ever mod, so I hope Alex isn’t too OOC (but I suppose that doesn’t really matter since this is a yandere mod?) If anyone has any suggestions for revisions, I’d love to hear them.
[i][size=1]Please let me know about any typos, repetitiveness, errors, etc in the mod. I’ll fix them ASAP. 
[/size][/i]
[/size][/i][/center][left][b][size=5]Warnings![/size] [/b]
[i][size=1]*There are behaviors depicted in this mod that may be uncomfortable or triggering. Download at your own risk. This mod is purely fictional and I do not condone this behavior irl[/size][/i]
Swearing 
Violence
Animal cruelty
Obsessive/psychotic behavior
Suggestive Themes

[size=5]Instructions[/size]
1. Make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed. Unique Courtship is optional
2. Unzip the file
3. Open your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder and drop the folder called "[CP] Yandere Alex Dialogue Expansion" there
That's it!
[size=1][i]*To see solely the yandere dialogue using "Unique Courtship", open the mod file and go to the config.json and change the switch "enableAlex" from "enabled" to "disabled"
*You must first reach 2 hearts with Alex before any yandere dialogue will appear[/i][/size]

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Unique Courtship (optional, it allows unique bouquet and pendant dialogue) 

[size=5]Use[/size]
[i][size=2]*Uploading videos, screenshots, etc is perfectly fine
*You are allowed to edit this mod for your own use
*Do not upload this mod on other sites[/size][/i][/left]
[i][size=1][center]*Alex will refer to the player as either male or female. If there’s anyone who would like me to change the dialogue to be gender-neutral, I’ll happily do so.[/center][/size][/i][center][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7921]Yandere Haley[/url]﻿[/center]
